# Six live previews in two v10 blog posts import from 'neo.mjs' and never run

## Context

The #21870 lane ran every `live-preview` block in `learn/` headless in a local Portal on `dev` (a throwaway probe that opens each page, clicks each Preview tab and reads the panel): 87 previews on 31 pages. All render except six, all in two v10 blog posts, and each shows the same error text instead of its demo:

| Post | Block (line) | Panel shows |
|---|---|---|
| `learn/blog/v10-deep-dive-functional-components.md` | 212 | `Failed to resolve module specifier 'neo.mjs'` |
| `learn/blog/v10-deep-dive-state-provider.md` | 61, 113, 162, 227 | `Failed to resolve module specifier 'neo.mjs/src/button/Base.mjs'` (or `…/container/Base.mjs`) |
| same | 264 | `Failed to resolve module specifier 'neo.mjs'` |

On neomjs.com (`/news/blog/v10-deep-dive-state-provider`, `/news/blog/v10-deep-dive-functional-components`) the same previews render an empty panel.

## The Problem

A reader who clicks Preview on these posts gets an error string or nothing, in two of the posts that explain v10's reactivity model. The imports are bare specifiers, `'neo.mjs'` and `'neo.mjs/src/…'`, and nothing on the preview's path maps them: the Portal has no import map, and the `neo.mjs` package declares neither `main` nor `exports`, so `from 'neo.mjs'` would not resolve in an app either.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.code.executor.Neo` turns each `import` line into a dynamic `import()` and rebases only paths that start with `.` (`src/code/executor/Neo.mjs`, the `importRegex` loop): `'../button/Base.mjs'` for `development` and `dist/esm`, and two `dist/*` variants. A bare specifier passes through unchanged and the browser refuses it.
- Every other live preview in `learn/` (81 of 87) imports with paths relative to `src/code/`, e.g. `import Button from '../button/Base.mjs'`; `defineComponent` and `useConfig` are exported by `src/functional/_export.mjs`.

## The Fix

In the six blocks only, the import lines use the live-preview convention: `'neo.mjs/src/<path>'` → `'../<path>'`, and `'neo.mjs'` → `'../functional/_export.mjs'`. No prose, claim or other code changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The probe re-run on the branch finds all six previews rendering their demo, with no error text, in a local Portal.
- [ ] AC-2: No `live-preview` block in `learn/` imports from a bare `neo.mjs` specifier.

## Out of Scope

- **The non-preview code blocks of the v10 posts** (`v10-deep-dive-reactivity.md` and others) that show `from 'neo.mjs'`: they are illustrations, not run, though the root specifier resolves nowhere today. A follow-up if a reader trips on one.
- **Teaching the executor bare `neo.mjs/…` specifiers:** an engine change for six blocks; the convention every other preview follows is enough.
- The posts' prose and claims.
